canonical_project: National AI and Data Competency Center
owner: Maldives Innovation and Digital Company (MINDCo) / Bank of Maldives
notes: Muslim Network TV reported a government-backed plan for a national Artificial Intelligence and Data Competency Center, led by Maldives Innovation and Digital Company with Bank of Maldives as strategic partner, scheduled to begin operations in April 2026. Included as a planned data/AI competency center rather than a confirmed physical colocation data centre; no site or MW capacity was disclosed.
